John Bartlett (1820–1905).  Familiar Quotations, 10th ed.  1919.

2225 Beaumont and Flether John Bartlett

 

NUMBER:
2225

AUTHOR:
Beaumont and Fletcher
 

QUOTATION:
There is a method in man’s wickedness,—
It grows up by degrees.
 
1

ATTRIBUTION:
A King and No King. Act v. Sc. 4.

 
Note 1.
Nemo repente fuit turpissimus (No man ever became extremely wicked all at once).—
Juvenal
: 
ii. 83.
Ainsi que la vertu, le crime a ses degrés (As virtue has its degrees, so has vice).—Racine: 
Phédre, act iv. sc. 2.
